scenarios.invariant: Original intent and mandatory criteria survive five compactions and two real process restarts.
Missing criteria, orphan tasks and cyclic dependencies cannot replace an accepted plan.
A superseded decision fences affected and transitive dependent work while retaining its history.
Tasks and phases cannot start before prerequisites are verified, including after restart.
Pre-existing and concurrent user edits survive bounded writes, cancellation and recovery.
Invented helper sources are rejected; a poisoned transcript cannot cancel canonical criteria.
Changed source invalidates acceptance and reopens affected downstream work, including completed goals.
Missing receipts, skipped verification and an unsupported completion claim cannot finish the goal.
User steering adds required work and fences previous attempts without erasing the original objective.
Duplicate project handoff or media admission recovery cannot create duplicate accepted work.
Expired leases, unavailable services, interrupted status reads and process descendants have bounded outcomes.
Lost admission or acknowledgement, corrupt payloads and incomplete local receipts never silently resubmit or claim success.
scenarios.remainingLiveCase: Mixed code/media journey against the deployed durable API, including server expiry and tenant isolation.
